title: CVNSS Preprints: GitHub-based arXiv-mini archive for CVNSS4.0 and Vietnamese NLP
description: CVNSS Preprints is an open GitHub Pages archive for CVNSS4.0, Vietnamese NLP, orthographic audit, intermediate representation, and domain-specific AI/NLP/LLM research. This release archives a public preprint package; protected CVNSS rule tables and converter PRO artifacts are not included unless explicitly stated.
